about: The WP12a gold places everyone at the table from the scene's start, yet beat 1 (shots 010 and 020) happens at the back door, as its own staging line, dial (beat 1 at 2.3 metres) and shots say. This proposed fix for WP12b puts the start at the door and brings the four in with floor-plan moves at the cut to shot 030 (beat 2). wp4a_derive_acceptance.py applies it to a temporary copy only while the gold still has the old start lines.
